step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture processes genomic data. Ad-hoc EC2 instances ingest raw sequencing data (ATCG) and store it in Amazon FSx. Containerized pipeline images stored in Amazon ECR are pulled by Amazon EKS, which processes the mounted FSx data at scale. Cleaned matrix data is output to an S3-backed Data Lake, which internal data scientists and biologists (UserCompanyDeveloper) query.
